pkgmetadata.longdescription: qeth is a Qt (PySide6) Ethereum wallet for the desktop, with Ledger hardware-wallet support and a Frame-compatible JSON-RPC server on 127.0.0.1:1248. The Ethereum library stack (web3, eth-*, and their narrowly-pinned compiled deps) is vendored from source into a private tree; PySide6 and the other generic dependencies come from the system.

use.flag: Transaction preview via a bundled local py-evm fork engine
Air-gapped QR signing and camera scanning (pulls Qt Multimedia)
Ledger hardware-wallet support (qeth's own client, over dev-python/hidapi)
Install the Falkon browser connector plugin
Install the Chrome/Chromium extension package for manual loading
